bio.text: Greg Cunningham is the Republican nominee for New Mexico's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Rep. Gabe Vasquez.
He is a former U.S. Marine and retired Albuquerque Police Department detective, and his South Valley home became part of the district after redistricting.
He lost two races for state House District 29, in 2022 and 2024, to Rep. Joy Garrett.

sources.title: New Mexico Election 2026: US House of Representatives, District 2
